import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp")
from harness import *

def one(raw, **kw):
    return run(batch([job(raw=raw, **kw)]))[0]

# ---------------- privacy / PAI emission ----------------
r = one(req(extra=("Privacy: id",)))
check("private local trusted_out", (r["private"], "P-Asserted-Identity" in r["wire"], r["identity"]), (True, True, "sip:ember@studio.test"))
r = one(req(extra=("Privacy: id",)), trusted=False)
check("private local not trusted_out", (r["private"], "P-Asserted-Identity" in r["wire"]), (True, False))
r = one(req(frm="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=q7"))
check("anon from trusted_out", (r["private"], "P-Asserted-Identity" in r["wire"], r["wire"].split("\r\n")[1]),
       (True, True, "From: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=q7"))
r = one(req(frm="<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=q7"), trusted=False)
check("anon from not trusted_out", (r["private"], "P-Asserted-Identity" in r["wire"]), (True, False))
r = one(req())
check("plain trusted_out", (r["private"], "P-Asserted-Identity" in r["wire"]), (False, True))
r = one(req(), trusted=False)
check("plain not trusted_out", (r["private"], "P-Asserted-Identity" in r["wire"]), (False, True))
r = one(req(extra=("Privacy: none",)))
check("privacy none wire", r["wire"].split("\r\n")[5], "Privacy: none")

# ---------------- source reuse / chains ----------------
jobs = [
    job(raw=req(extra=("Privacy: id",)), trusted=False),        # 0: private, PAI stripped
    job(gw="inside", ingress={"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}, trusted=True, source=0),  # 1: no PAI -> unauth
    job(gw="inside", ingress={"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}, trusted=True, source=1),  # 2: upstream
    job(raw=req(), trusted=True),                               # 3: ok, PAI present
    job(gw="inside", ingress={"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}, trusted=False, source=3), # 4: peer accept private? no
    job(gw="inside", ingress={"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}, trusted=True, source=4),  # 5: chain on
    job(gw="edge", ingress={"kind":"untrusted"}, trusted=True, source=5),             # 6: unauth
    job(gw="narrow", ingress={"kind":"peer","name":"edge"}, trusted=True, source=3),  # 7: identity
]
res = run(batch(jobs))
check("chain results", [x["status"] + (":"+x.get("reason","") if x["status"]=="reject" else ":"+x["identity"]) for x in res],
      ["accept:sip:ember@studio.test", "reject:unauthenticated", "reject:upstream",
       "accept:sip:ember@studio.test", "accept:sip:ember@studio.test",
       "accept:sip:ember@studio.test", "reject:unauthenticated", "reject:identity"])
check("chain 5 wire from", res[5]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1], "From: <sip:ember@studio.test>;tag=q7")
check("chain 4 private", res[4]["private"], False)
check("chain 5 basis", res[5]["basis"], "peer")

# chain that re-privatizes: hop1 private strips PAI; hop2 local re-adds identity
jobs = [
    job(raw=req(extra=("Privacy: id",)), trusted=False),
    job(ingress={"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"}, trusted=True, source=0),
]
res = run(batch(jobs))
check("reprivate hop2", (res[1]["status"], res[1]["private"], res[1]["identity"]),
      ("accept", True, "sip:ember@studio.test"))
check("reprivate hop2 wire", res[1]["wire"].split("\r\n")[1], "From: <sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>;tag=q7")

# ---------------- length limits ----------------
long_callid = "x" * 128
r = one(req(callid=long_callid))
check("128 callid ok", r["status"], "accept")

def big_req(n):
    # pad an X-header so total request text length == n
    base = req()
    pad = n - len(base)
    assert pad > 10, pad
    hdr = "X-Pad: " + "p" * (pad - 10)
    lines = base.split("\r\n")
    return "\r\n".join(lines[:5] + [hdr] + lines[5:])

check("32768 ok", one(big_req(32768))["status"], "accept")
check("32769 syntax", run(batch([job(raw=big_req(32769))])), [rej("syntax")])

# wire growth beyond 32768 across a hop
long_to = "sip:" + "u" * 120 + "@" + "d" * 60 + ".test"
base = req(to="<%s>" % long_to)
pad = 32768 - len(base)
hdr = "X-Pad: " + "p" * (pad - 10)
lines = base.split("\r\n")
raw = "\r\n".join(lines[:3] + [hdr] + lines[3:])
assert len(raw) == 32768, len(raw)
res = run(batch([job(raw=raw), job(ingress={"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"}, source=0)]))
check("hop growth accept", res[0]["status"], "accept")
check("hop2 length on grown wire", res[1]["status"], "accept")

# source referencing an accepted job whose wire exceeds the limit -> syntax
identity_long = "sip:" + "n" * 200 + "@" + "m" * 50 + ".test"
b = batch([job(raw=req()), job(ingress={"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"}, source=0)],
          directory={"sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
                     "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"],
                     identity_long: ["tel:+12025550121x"]})
# simpler: craft raw near limit with short From alias, selected identity much longer
b = batch([job(raw=req()), job(ingress={"kind":"local","subject":"session-k"}, source=0)])
res = run(b)
check("plain chain still ok", res[1]["status"], "accept")

# empty jobs
check("no jobs", run(batch([])), [])

# multiple PAI lines total 3 -> syntax
check("3 pai lines", run(batch([job(raw=req(extra=("P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ember@studio.test>",
    "P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550121>", "P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550122>")))])), [rej("syntax")])

summary()
PYEOF
